items.source: IOException - in case of general resolution/reading failures
items.translation: IOException - 在发生通用解析/读取失败时

items.source: FileNotFoundException - if the resource cannot be resolved as a file
items.translation: FileNotFoundException - 如果无法将资源解析为文件

items.source: FileNotFoundException - if the resource cannot be resolved as absolute file path, i.e. if the resource is not available in a file system
items.translation: FileNotFoundException - 如果资源无法解析为绝对文件路径，即该资源在文件系统中不可用时。

items.source: A value of true suggests (but does not guarantee) that a getFile() call will succeed. For non-default file systems, getFilePath() is the more reliable follow-up call.
items.translation: true 值表示（但不保证）getFile() 调用将成功。对于非默认文件系统，getFilePath() 是更可靠的后续调用。

items.source: Will be true for typical resource descriptors that exist since it strictly implies exists() semantics as of 5.1. Note that actual content reading may still fail when attempted. However, a value of false is a definitive indication that the resource content cannot be read.
items.translation: 对于自 5.1 版本起严格蕴含exists()语义的典型资源描述符，该值将为true。请注意，尝试读取实际内容时仍可能失败。然而，false的值明确表明无法读取资源内容。

items.source: The default implementation returns Channels.newChannel(InputStream) with the result of InputStreamSource.getInputStream().
items.translation: 默认实现返回Channels.newChannel(InputStream)，参数为InputStreamSource.getInputStream()的结果。

items.source: This method performs a definitive existence check, whereas the existence of a Resource handle only guarantees a valid descriptor handle.
items.translation: 此方法执行确切的生存性检查，而 `<code>Resource` 句柄的存在仅保证有效的描述符句柄。

items.source: Will be false for typical resource descriptors.

items.source: This is conservatively false by default.
items.translation: 这默认保守地设置为false。

items.source: Returns null if this type of resource does not have a filename.
items.translation: 如果此类型资源没有文件名，则返回null。

items.source:
An InputStream can be opened for every resource if it exists in
physical form, but a URL or File handle can just be returned for
certain resources. The actual behavior is implementation-specific.
items.translation: 如果资源以物理形式存在，则可以为每个资源打开一个 InputStream，但对于某些资源，只需返回 URL 或 File 句柄。实际行为取决于具体实现。

items.source: Note: This only works for files in the default file system.
items.translation: 注意：这仅适用于默认文件系统中的文件。

items.translation: 注：此功能也适用于非默认文件系统中的文件。

items.source: Implementations are encouraged to return the filename unencoded.
items.translation: 建议实现时返回未编码的文件名。
